subtasks.title: Include projectRoot in phase-change events
subtasks.description: Add the orchestrator's project path to every phase-change event emission so the server can route broadcasts by project.
acceptance_criteria: All processManager.emit('phase-change', ...) calls include a projectRoot field
The projectRoot matches the project path the orchestrator was constructed with

subtasks.title: Server-side project tracking and broadcast filtering
subtasks.description: Parse the 'project' query param from WebSocket upgrade URLs. Store ws.projectRoot. Filter phase-change, container-state, and container-log broadcast loops to only send to clients whose projectRoot matches the event's projectRoot.
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket upgrade handler parses ?project=<path> query param
Clients without ?project= param receive all events (backwards compatible)
Clients with ?project= only receive events for their project

subtasks.title: Client-side project declaration in useWebSocket
subtasks.description: Add optional 'project' parameter to useWebSocket. When provided, append ?project=<encoded-path> to the WebSocket URL so the server knows which project the client is viewing.
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket URL becomes ws://host/ws?project=<encoded-path> when project is provided
No query param when project is not provided (backwards compatible)

subtasks.title: Pass project path through usePhaseSync to useWebSocket
subtasks.description: Add optional 'project' parameter to usePhaseSync. Forward it to useWebSocket so the phase-sync connection declares its project scope.
acceptance_criteria: project param is passed through to useWebSocket

subtasks.title: Wire project path through frontend components
subtasks.description: Pass the active project path to usePhaseSync in KanbanBoard, PhasedKanban, WorkflowView, and PhaseSyncer. Each component receives the project path as a prop from its server-rendered parent page.
acceptance_criteria: PhasedKanban passes filename-derived path to usePhaseSync
